gl:definition.gl:content: (abstract) representation of a set of instance assets with common characteristics and features

gl:notes.gl:content: The set of instance assets may exist or may not exist.

gl:examples.gl:content: Examples of type assets are type of material, a product type, a type of a part, a device type, a machine type, a type of software, a type of control system, a type of production system.

gl:ref.gl:source: IDTA-01001-3.2:2026 (Specification of the Asset Administration Shell — Part 1: Metamodel)
